reviews.title: Resident Evil
reviews.review: Very very cool film. I really enjoyed it. It was a great ride and love the nods to the game. I didn't think it had the ingenuity of Weapons but it was like a really good roller coaster and I had a really good time. Ending was lol.

reviews.title: Ghost Elephants
reviews.review: God I love a herzhog documentary just the journey, the strangeness (in labs vs. on the plains), the music and arm chair travel to such a African mysticism and royalty vs. an inside look behind the Smithsonian at DC. Top stuff as always from Herzhog.

reviews.title: Send Help
reviews.review: Very fun. Sam Raimi still got it. Great acting and some great survival tips. And funny! And gross!

reviews.title: F1
reviews.review: I do love my Bruckheimer films but this was extremely forgettable. Hilarious cameos. Some of the writing was super cringe. Most dadcore thing I've seen all year bar Reacher.

reviews.title: Do the Right Thing
reviews.review: By far the best spike Lee film. I love the build up to the pure insanity of it. Very touching and snapshot of Harlem. Very smart film and really well done. V impressed.

reviews.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
reviews.review: If you like evil dead rises you're going to like this cuz it's the same film based in Egypt. Some very smart editing and sound design really enjoyable. I hope Lee does more. I'm a big fan.

reviews.title: Midnight Run
reviews.review: Very predictable but a lot of fun. Reminded me of Blues Brothers at times. Really fun De Niro portrayal, tough guy, desperate bounty but yeah really a lot of fun. Worth sitting down and watching this one, I reckon.

reviews.title: The Odyssey
reviews.review: Loved it maybe too much going on but Nolan is truly the master story-teller. The cyclops scene was my fave. Some of it was a bit forgettable but man it was so so cool and I watched it in the Imax which was so loud my seat shook!

reviews.title: Face/Off
reviews.review: Forgot how perfect this film is. So goofy I love it. Man I gotta watch more John Woo. Such an amazing act by Cage too.

reviews.title: Backrooms
reviews.review: It's slow but very memorable horror. I love liminal spaces and this did a great job of it. I also liked where the story went. I wish there was a bit more to it. It's still a very very solid horror. Really enjoyed it and had a great time with it and the lead actor, who never impresses me in anything, was very impressive.

reviews.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
reviews.review: This film absolutely ruled what a great ensemble. It was a lil all over the place and I thought the local villains deserve more but the protagonists were amazing and I loved the direction of it. I desperately want to see more Punisher-Spider-Man combo and it was a great ride. I think tight up there with No Way Home as my favourite.

reviews.title: Moneyball
reviews.review: Phenomenal film. Really epic and I love all the stats. Jonah hill great and it's great Michael Lewis stuff with Fenway Park at the end! I knew it would be great I don't know why I slept on it for so long.

reviews.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
reviews.review: Heavy heavy stuff. Incredible case of human greed cutting corners on safety. Heroes at the station and cowards in corporate. Illustrates what happened really well and I've always been interested. I should watch more HBO docs.

reviews.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
reviews.review: Terrible. Worst thing James Cameron has ever done. Things didn't even make sense from a story perspective. Motivations where all over the place and the acting was laughable. Two starts for cool explosions and effects.

reviews.title: GoodFellas
reviews.review: I absolutely loved it! A day in the life of the mob, really authentic and gritty and exciting. The soundtrack is great and the Ray is amazing! So many other scenes are just so recognisable. Brilliant piece of work!

reviews.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
reviews.review: Doesn't hold a candle to the dollars trilogy but i did like the depiction of the end of the wild West. The characters are so odd. Claudia Cardinale's in particularly but I guess it just sucks to be a woman back in the day and you just gotta do everything and anything to survive. The pacing is all over the place a times. Things are very slow in pace and then done very quickly without motivation but the acting is fantastic. Sergio Leone is brilliant as always though sometimes the score is very goofy while the film is absolutely not.

reviews.title: The Invite
reviews.review: Very mid a24 film with some funny bits but man Seth rogen... I really dislike him.. But it wasn't terrible. Edward Norton was good. I liked the setting but v forgettable.

reviews.title: The Producers
reviews.review: Matthew Broderick is so awful he destroyed the entire picture. He stopped this from being a 4.5 singlehandedly. Very fun though. Great songs.

reviews.title: American Hustle
reviews.review: Well acted but disjointed. Felt like I was watching a bunch of actors than a cohesive narrative. Bale was great.

reviews.title: American Gangster
reviews.review:
American Gangster is another reminder of the incredible range of Ridley Scott. I thoroughly enjoyed watching Denzel Washington swagger through the film, seemingly saying "my man" every five minutes, while Russell Crowe plays perhaps the sleaziest honest cop ever put on screen.
There's a particularly shocking scene involving Idris Elba that stuck with me. The film does lose momentum in places, and some parts felt a little hard to believe, but overall it's an entertaining gangster epic with strong performances and plenty of memorable moments. A good film.

reviews.title: The Drama
reviews.review:
I liked the drama. I thought it had run out of steam toward the end, but then it managed to pull me back in. It's my favourite kind of drama: a great premise combined with a horribly cringe-inducing study of human behaviour that leaves you with plenty to think about long after it's finished.
The performances are excellent. I never really rated Robert Pattinson that highly before, but he was very good in this, and Zendaya was great as well. I'd definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: Days and Nights in the Forest
reviews.review: Tedious not very funny and kind of creepy. Glad I wentto the cinema to watch this but so not my kind of thing

reviews.title: The Sheep Detectives
reviews.review: Great detective story with a lot of heart. Characters aren't great besides Emma Thomson and Hugh Jason but I liked the sheep gimmicks and Bryan Cranston voiced a very memorable one. But it's an excellent who dunnit.

reviews.title: Yojimbo
reviews.review: Very very cool film. Mifune is such a badass his swashbuckling and galavanting is so cool and the town is amazing. I really enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Song Sung Blue
reviews.review: Really great. Loved Hugh Jackman singing and the twists and turns. I wish the first half was a bit more engaging but Jackson and Hudson are oozing with charming.

reviews.title: Train Dreams
reviews.review: Very moving and great acting from Joel. Bit slow and it sort of petered out but I love the world, the emotion, the acting and the feel of what it was like being a logger from the 20s to the 60s.

reviews.title: Apex
reviews.review: I really liked Edgerton I hope he does more things. I like the momentum of the film but felt theron was a bit flat and the ending was a a bit meh and the film very generic.

reviews.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
reviews.review: Glorious violence. Giving up ghosts to kill everyone in his block. Short and sweet. If not a bit pointless.

reviews.title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
reviews.review: Shit go really nuts huh. Those are completely ruined by avengers. Seems like a Woody Allen character who's completely over his head - still managed to produce a banging film despite the chaos

reviews.title: Mortal Kombat II
reviews.review: Extremely fun romp with karl urban. Ightly shite first 30 minutes but otherwise great film. Lots of violence.
